{{Quote|Local Rodian, Cien Wenzz, was seen last night looting a freighter filled with spice. Locals say he disabled the freighter, docked with it and stole all the spice it was carrying to Dantooine. If you've seen him, please contact the Imperial Navy.|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
'''Cien Wenzz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wenzz attacked a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] carrying [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The Rodian disabled the freighter, docked with it and successfully stole the spice. After this attack, Cien Wenzz was wanted by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and his description was broadcasted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] news agencies.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cien Wenzz was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IDN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Cien Wenzz was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />
